visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a grey and white striped collared shirt, sits at a bar counter. He is eating noodles with chopsticks. The background features shelves filled with various liquor bottles and a small white electric fan blowing. (2) The scene cuts to a historical black-and-white photograph of an elderly man with glasses, Momofuku Ando. This is followed by a close-up of a metal pot where noodles are being stirred in boiling water by chopsticks. (3) Two hands in business suits are shown shaking in a deal. Then, a close-up shows a bundle of dried yellow noodles. Another cutaway shows a bowl of white rice topped with small fried shallots and meat. (4) An image of a vintage instant noodle package with a prominent red chicken logo and the words "Sunli Men" appears. This is followed by dramatic footage of tropical palm trees swaying violently during a heavy rainstorm. (5) A close-up of a prepared bowl of ramen with three slices of ham, a fried egg, and green garnish is shown. Then, a person wrapped from head to toe in white bandages like a mummy appears. (6) A small white hamster is shown on a white cloth eating pink and yellow bow-tie pasta. Finally, the main male character returns to the bar setting, gesturing energetically and pointing at the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 聽說泡麵是臺灣人發明的哦. [Logo]: 東亞史探索課. [Variety]: 歷史老師. [Slogan]: 真的問什麼都答得出來嗎？(2) [Subtitle]: 沒錯沒錯. (3) [Subtitle]: 日清的創辦人 安藤百福 原名叫做 吳百福. (4) [Subtitle]: 偶然間看到他的妻子 在炸天婦羅 靈感就迸發了. (5) [Subtitle]: 但也有另外一個說法 認為發明的人 是另外一個 留日的臺灣人 張國文. (6) [Subtitle]: 只是他後來把專利 賣給了 安藤百福. (7) [Subtitle]: 都有臺灣人的身影 因為臺灣人其實在那之前 就有誕生出很像泡麵的 雞絲麵. (8) [Subtitle]: 到日本才流行起來. [Variety]: 為什麼？？ (9) [Subtitle]: 臺灣早期還是以 米飯 為主食 吃麵都少了 更不用說要吃泡麵. (10) [Subtitle]: 1968年 日清跟臺灣的食品公司合作 推出 生力麵. (11) [Subtitle]: 打開了大眾的視野 剛好又有幾個颱風助攻 發現生力麵很方便 變成了 賑災神器. (12) [Subtitle]: 泡麵在早期還被當作 營養食品. [Variety]: 營養食品. (13) [Subtitle]: 那時候泡麵還結合 雞蛋 雞肉汁 曾被認為是 濃縮了人體所需的營養. [Variety]: 不是吧. (14) [Subtitle]: 這個說法很多人都不認同 早期一種說法就是 如果你常吃泡麵 你會變成 木乃伊. (15) [Subtitle]: 1981年 政府公佈了一個報告 讓白老鼠吃泡麵 連續吃了一段時間 發現老鼠身體 出了些問題. (16) [Subtitle]: 泡麵本身 它有很多問題嗎 也還好. (17) [Subtitle]: 注意到 營養均衡 留言「泡麵」告訴你更多相關知識哦.
